audit_items.proof_trace: All protocol lending entry points (borrow, withdraw, liquidate, flash_loan) accept `x_oracle: &XOracle` (immutable). Sui's PTB object model prohibits mixing `&XOracle` and `&mut XOracle` for the same shared object in one PTB, so `refresh_usd_price` cannot execute in the same PTB as any health-check operation. Within a single PTB, both `debts_value_usd_non_liquidation` and `collaterals_usd_non_liquidation` read from the identical frozen XOracle state, and `get_price_with_check` returns stable EMA prices with a staleness check enforcing recency.
